entries.german: [Nachtragshand am Rand: Senderr Franckenber] Im Jare 1419 am freitag vor Inuocauit name B Johanns von Brun iiiii m fl von Contzen von Rosenberg zu [unleserlich]tingen Wonhafft vnd verschribe ime darfur die stat vnd ambt Jphouen mit allen seinen gefellen vnd nutzungen die offnung, volg Erbhuldung ausgenomen, Recepta in i debitorum Brun fo 214. Aber in dem nechsten Jare hernach löset ime B Johanns wider ab vnd dartzu lihen ime Hanns von Seldenck der elter vnd Hanns der Junger sein sun iii m fl von welchen iii m fl inen B Johanns Jerlich iii c fl zins verschribe Jnen auch derwegen stat vnd ambt Jphouen einsatzt mit burgschafft actum am tag Georgii anno 1420 Recepta in i debitorum Brun fo. 255 diese verschreibung ist nit furgangen
entries.english: [Marginal addition: Sendelbach, Frankenberg.] In 1419, on the Friday before Invocavit, Johann von Brunn, Bischof, borrowed 5,000 florins from Kunz von Rosenberg, resident at [illegible]tingen, and in return pledged to him the town and Amt Iphofen with all their revenues and uses, excepting the right of access and the hereditary homage. In the following year Johann von Brunn, Bischof, redeemed it and additionally borrowed 3,000 florins from Hans von Seldeneck the Elder and Hans the Younger, his son. For this sum the bishop pledged them the town and Amt Iphofen and undertook to pay them 300 florins annual interest; he also gave them a surety. Done on St George’s Day, 1420. This bond did not take effect.

facts.content: lent Bishop Johann von Brunn 5,000 florins and received the town and Amt Iphofen as a pledge, with the right of access and hereditary homage excepted.
had the pledge of the town and Amt Iphofen redeemed by Bishop Johann von Brunn.
